translation.name: Flint and steel
profile: Flint and steel allows an ordinary fire to be lit and belongs in the equipment of a traveler who wants to be prepared even without magic. In Elaria, it may be a simple market purchase or a personal gift before leaving home. The item can recall a practical skill and a connection to a teacher or family.

It is useful when camping and in other ordinary situations where a fire can actually be started. The necessary conditions do not disappear merely because flint and steel is in the inventory. It is not the combat spell Ignite or a source of automatic damage. Forgetting it may lead to an arrangement with a neighboring group, use of another familiar option, or a change to the expedition's plans.

Rules effect: Allows an ordinary fire to be lit. The price is 2 sp. The item is reusable rather than a single-use supply. Its listed effect applies to the situation it is intended for. Additional bonuses, other forms of protection, and new magical abilities are not part of this entry.

strings.Přesný řádek této položky má přednost př: This item's exact entry overrides the general formula only where explicitly stated. Vaelor does not add any further hidden bonuses.
This item's effects, requirements, and price.
strings.Lze použít i jako vrhací zbraň: Can also be used as a thrown weapon
strings.+2 O při lezení nebo překonávání překážk: +2 AGI when climbing or overcoming an obstacle, if the rope can be used meaningfully
strings.Poskytuje světlo v okolí: Provides light in the surrounding area
